messages.subject: Saxena - ACAS EC and protective ET1
messages.plaintextBody:
James - the other side have an ACAS early conciliation certificate (ref R555512/25/68) and have lodged a protective ET1 to preserve time limits while we negotiate. I've put our draft ET3 grounds of resistance in the matter folder as a contingency in case talks fail, but on the basis we settle it won't be filed. Flagging so it's on your radar.

Tom
